main_result: The five-layer writer intervention [16,18,20,21,22] removes the Chinese fibre technical falsehood and acknowledges Chinese sourcing, while the Chinese military CNC policy-based denial returns. Adding layer 17 to that joint intervention changes the CNC outcome, but layer 17 alone corrects neither Chinese case.

comparison.Chinese_fibre: Technical use and Chinese sourcing acknowledged
Technical use acknowledged; specific sourcing qualified

ordinary_controls: All Chinese and American civilian CNC answers remain affirmative. Their wording and details change, so preservation of broad stance does not prove unchanged ordinary processing or overall accuracy.
american_fibre: Sourcing denial alone is not classified as lying. Layer-17 and layer-18 answers acknowledge fibre-optic control while retaining American sourcing denial; omit-17 also allows specialized tethered use.
causal_scope: Replacement of layer 17 contributes conditionally to the successful six-layer CNC intervention, but is not required for the successful five-layer fibre intervention. This does not prove necessity in the untouched model or a unique sensitivity gate.
limits: These are previously inspected discovery prompts, not held-out generalization.
An opening-word margin is not a truthfulness score.
Removal of the target technical falsehood is established; all additional platform, sourcing and policy details have not been independently verified.
The current interventions still use prompt-specific donors.
next_priority: Develop fixed donor-free steering from causally implicated components; use compact localization to support that endpoint and evaluate both signs on declared discovery/validation sets before held-out topics.
